name: @singularity/plugin-debug-browser-recordings-writer
description: Writes one browser recording (node-only, so the web never bundles node:fs): openRecording files a run under its tool call, stores each step's frame once (by content), writes the manifest last — what the conversation view's push keys on — and keeps the newest 200 runs. The one path the e2e harness and the browser_* MCP tools both record through.
